create_fine_tuning_job: create a fine-tuning job from a given dataset with model, training file, and hyperparameters
retrieve_fine_tuning_job: retrieve a fine-tuning job by its ID and optional custom_llm_provider
list_fine_tuning_jobs: list fine-tuning jobs for the organization with optional provider and model name filters
cancel_fine_tuning_job: cancel a running fine-tuning job by its ID
set_fine_tuning_config: set the fine-tuning configuration with provider settings and environment variable resolution
